title: Drag-and-drop email export to Windows Explorer no longer works in Thunderbird 153.0.2esr
creator: samsungchobg
content:
Environment:

Thunderbird: 153.0.2esr (64-bit) Operating system: Windows Occurs with multiple email accounts Reproduced on two different computers running the same Thunderbird version

Description:

After updating Thunderbird to version 153.0.2esr, released on 4 August 2026, emails can no longer be dragged and dropped from Thunderbird to the Windows Desktop or any folder in Windows Explorer.

The problem occurs with all tested email accounts and folders. It has been reproduced independently on two different Windows computers using the same Thunderbird version.

Saving an email manually with Ctrl+S works correctly and creates the .eml file. Normal drag-and-drop between folders in Windows Explorer also works. Only dragging an email from Thunderbird to Windows Explorer fails.

The issue also appears to affect third-party applications that use Thunderbird to create or send emails automatically.

Steps to reproduce:

Open Thunderbird 153.0.2esr on Windows. Select an email in any account or folder. Drag the email to the Desktop or another folder in Windows Explorer. Release the mouse button.

Actual result:

The email is not copied or saved to the selected Windows folder.

Expected result:

Thunderbird should export the email as an .eml file in the selected folder.

Additional information:

Ctrl+S successfully saves the same email. The issue affects every tested email account. Thunderbird extensions were disabled, but the problem remained. Thunderbird Troubleshoot Mode did not resolve the issue. Restarting Thunderbird, Windows Explorer and Windows did not resolve it. Thunderbird and Windows Explorer are not running with different elevation levels. The problem was reproduced on a second computer after installing the same Thunderbird version. No relevant error is shown in Thunderbird’s Error Console when the drag-and-drop operation fails. The issue was not present before the recent Thunderbird update.

This appears to be a regression in Thunderbird 153.0.2esr affecting email export through drag-and-drop and possibly Thunderbird’s integration with external applications.

title: Jak spravne nastavit thunderbird pro pop3?

content: Jak spravne nastavit thunderbird? Pouzival jsem thunderbird jako postovni klient cca v 2020-24. I drive. Nekolik uctu, pop3. Kdyz jsem ted preinstaloval PC a importem, nebo i kopirovanim prenesl data, Slozky sent, draft jsou prazdne. Pritom v datech jsou velike desitky MB. Puvodni PC odmitl nastartovat TB - nemuze spustit soubor - nevspominam si jaky. Je to nejspise bezny problem, v interetu doporucovali preinstalovat TB. Nicmene nejdrive jsem zkopiroval slozku Thunderbird na USB. Po preinstalaci vidim normalne slozky Inbox, Sent, Draft, Junk, ale krome Inbox je vsude 0 Messages. To je jak na puvodnim PC (po preinstalaci - jaak bylo drive si nepamatuji, predpokladam, ze normalne - tudiz tam bylo vse), tak i na aktualnim. Zkousel jsem ruzne rady z internetu, nepovedlo se nic. Chtel bych jednak ziskat ztracena, nebo skryta data a jednak nadale pouzivat TB jako emailovy klient. POP3 mi vyhovoval, delal jsem, kdyz jsem potreboval bez ohledu na pripojeni. Delam pouze na PC - linux, nepotrebuji synchronizovat data na vice zarizenich. Bohuzel moje anglictina neni dostatecna abych dokazal vysvetlit co chci a pochopit odpoved, proto to zkousim tady. Dekuji predem. Bob.
